LanguageData.EAT_NotInGame: Load a game to see your colony's tech level and the factions that can raid it.
LanguageData.EAT_EligibleRaiders: Hostile factions that can raid you: {0}
LanguageData.EAT_TemperatureNote: Factions can still stay away when the map is too hot or too cold for them.
LanguageData.EAT_MethodHeader: Your colony's tech level comes from:
LanguageData.EAT_MethodPercent: Share of each level's research finished
LanguageData.EAT_MethodPercentTip: You reach a tech level once you have finished this share of its research. You never drop below the level you started at.
LanguageData.EAT_MethodHighestTip: You reach a tech level as soon as you finish one project from it.
LanguageData.EAT_MethodColonyTip: Ignores research. Useful with mods that raise your faction's tech level themselves.
LanguageData.EAT_MethodFixedTip: Choose the allowed tech levels directly. They never change during the game.
LanguageData.EAT_FilterRaidsTip: Random raids come from a faction in range. This also covers World Domination 2.0, Rim War, Winston Waves and [SR]Raid Extension.
LanguageData.EAT_KeepRaids: Keep raids when no faction is in range
LanguageData.EAT_KeepRaidsTip: When no faction in range can raid you, the closest faction comes instead. Turn this off to skip the raid. Factions set to Never are never used.
LanguageData.EAT_OutOfRangeChance: Chance a raid ignores the limit: {0}
LanguageData.EAT_OutOfRangeChanceTip: Lets the occasional raid come from outside the range. Factions set to Never are never used.
LanguageData.EAT_FilterIncidents: Limit mech clusters, crashed ship parts and infestations
LanguageData.EAT_FilterIncidentsTip: These follow the rule for mechanoids or insects in the list below. Threat events from supported mods are limited too.
LanguageData.EAT_FilterQuestSitesTip: Quests at enemy sites, such as siege camps, only use factions in range. A quest with no eligible faction isn't offered.
LanguageData.EAT_ReplaceQuestRaiders: Replace quest raiders from outside the range
LanguageData.EAT_ReplaceQuestRaidersTip: A faction in range arrives instead. The quest's text still names the original faction.
LanguageData.EAT_FilterVisitorsTip: Random trade caravans and visitors also only come from factions in range.
